rows.en: (I was training with Luca today, but...)
That was tiring, huh, Luca?
Are you hungry?
I sure am~
Wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan?
Yes, let's go!
Nanase might be there, too.

No, she has the day off today.
Nanase-san, I mean...
rows.notes: x2, Luca; the Japanese puts 'Nanase-san wa' as an afterthought, kept as one.

rows.en: (...How does he know her shifts...?)
Haah~ We sure ate a lot~
Thank you for the meal~
Mmm, so satisfied.
Hm? What? Something wrong?
rows.notes: Male; Luca has been staring silently.

rows.en:
\p-san, why did you
enroll at Mihoshi?
Huh? Where's this coming from all of a sudden?

Oh, it just crossed my mind...
So what's the real reason?

Hmm, why did I...
To find out what I want to do... maybe?

It's a good school for finding
what you want to do, right?
So, you still haven't found what you want to do?
Let's see...
rows.notes: x3: also male in scd_fes_804/805 before a choice between Alto and Michel.

rows.en: ...So that's about where I'm at, I guess?
rows.notes: Male; the player's explanation happens off-screen.

rows.en: I see, so that's how it is.

Well, it's all still ahead of us, right?
Both me and you, Luca.
Yes, definitely!
rows.notes: x10: Luca here; Nanase (frd_nns_006/007, Christmas scd_com_618); female player to Sheryl (frd_she_005, nml_she_002). Answers 'it's all ahead of us', 'balance in everything', 'let's play a bit more', 'shall we go inside?', 'wasn't it good?', 'let's enjoy it'; 'Yes, definitely!' fits all.

rows.en:
Thanks for the meal.
Sorry for letting you treat me.

I'm older than you, technically, so I've got to
do at least that much. Well, once you make it
big, you can treat me.
(Luca thinks about a lot of things, too.)
(I was training with Luca-kun today, but...)
That wore me out, huh, Luca-kun?
Wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan?
Nanase might be there, too~
(...How does he know her shifts...?)
Phew~ I'm so satisfied.
Huh? What? Something wrong?
Huh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

Hmm, why was it~?
To find out what I want to do... maybe?

It's a good school for finding
what you want to do, right?
...That's kind of where I'm at, I guess?

Well, it's all still ahead of us, right?
Both me and you, Luca-kun.

I'm older than you, technically, so I've got to
do at least that much. Well, once you make it
big, maybe I'll have you treat me.
So, shall we head home?
(Luca-kun thinks about a lot of things, too.)
(I was training with Luca again today, but...)
Luca, wanna go to Nyan-Nyan again today?
Huh? Oh! Y-yes!!

Man, it's important to have time
to just kick back, isn't it?

You're right.
I think so too, very much.
If only Nanase were here, it'd be perfect, huh?
Wh-why are you bringing up Nanase-san?!
Hmm, I wonder why?
(Ordinary days like this are what matter.)

(I was training with Luca-kun again today,
but...)
Luca-kun, wanna go to Nyan-Nyan again today?

It's important to have time
to just kick back, isn't it~
If only Nanase were here, it'd be perfect, huh~

(Ordinary days like this really are
what matter.)
(I came to eat with Luca, but...)

What's wrong, Luca?
You look kind of down...
Huh? Do I?

You've barely touched your food, either.
Is it not to your taste?
That's not it at all. It's really delicious!
Well, if you say so...
rows.notes: x3: also female in frd_rnk_106 (Ranka says she isn't bored).

rows.en: Um... \p-san.

\p-san, is there someone
you look up to?
rows.notes: x2, Luca. akogare: 'look up to' keeps the romance reading the player jokes about next.

rows.en: What's this all of a sudden?
Oh, no reason...

Hmm... someone I look up to, huh...
Are we talking about girls?
No, not that kind of thing...

So you mean looking up to someone
out of respect, that kind of thing?
Yes, that's it.
rows.notes: x4: also Nanase in frd_nns_001 ('doing assignments in the art room again?').

rows.en:
Hmm, that's tough...
There are so many, it's almost a problem.
I see.

What about you, Luca?
Is there someone you look up to?

Yes, I do. I've become really
conscious of them lately.
rows.notes: x2, Luca. 'them': he later says sono hito-tachi (plural).

rows.en: Huh, is that right?
rows.notes: x5: also frd_nns_004 (Nanase) and nml_yuu_016 (Akimizu), both genders.

rows.en:
Rather than looking up to them,
I'd say I see them more as rivals.
Though it's totally one-sided...

Huh. Well, I think that's a good thing.
A competitive spirit really drives you,
after all.
So, think you can beat this rival of yours?
As I am now, I'm no match for them.
Huh, really?

uncertain: c09169-c09181: akogare rendered 'look up to' so both the romance joke and the respect sense work; Luca's rivals kept as 'them' (he later says sono hito-tachi, plural).
c09129 (x10, many speakers) 'Yes, definitely!' chosen to fit every context.
